related.name: Caliper & Slide
related.description: Snip twelve runners, flip a tongue-bearing jaw and bond its underside keeper for a captive vernier teaching gauge. Measured sheet/socket reference, adjustable pitch, reach and calibrated gaps; local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL wing grips, connected-card and three-part STL/ZIP. Adhesive required; educational, not a calibrated instrument.

related.name: Sift & Sort
related.description: Snip 24 tabs and seat a graduated sorting deck on two inclined supports, then hand-guide three size-matched tokens through their first matching holes. Measured sheet/carrier reference, adjustable slope and calibrated mortises, local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL deck grips; connected-card, per-part STL and assembly ZIP. Adhesive required.

related.name: Five Soft Notes
related.description: Pluck five independently free-ended TPU tongues with graduated stiffness. Customize the isolated palm using local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief or verified ASCII/binary STL grips; tune tongue sections and export one support-free hardware-free solid.

related.name: Thumb Harp
related.description: Customize a one-piece pluck-comb fidget with graduated cantilever tines, rounded roots and scalloped palm rail. Live 3D preview, flex test coupon and local binary STL export.

decision: New four-part rolling-distance craft ruler: graduated wheel, pointer handle, flat axle, transverse keeper. Not a reskin of existing caliper or rolling handcart: length is read from circumference and fractional wheel ticks along a paper path.
